Kumkumadi Glow Face Oil

Saffron + 16 herbs for brighter, even-toned skin · 30ml
₹1,299₹1,599Inclusive of all taxes
Size

Kumkumadi Tailam is a classical Ayurvedic formulation made with saffron, sandalwood, manjistha and lotus, cold-infused in sesame oil for 21 days. Our version keeps the traditional recipe and swaps in a lighter base so it sinks in without leaving a greasy finish, which makes it suitable for night use on combination skin.

Use 3 to 4 drops on clean, damp skin at night. Press gently into the face and neck. Patch test before first use.

Rooted in Ayurveda

Every batch is slow-infused in small copper vessels in our Rishikesh workshop.
